books.description: Pregnant with Lennox Foster’s baby, Nora Shaw can hear her unborn child’s voice and get on-the-spot advice. She lands a job in the Foster home as a gold-medal maternity nanny, caring for their quintuplets while hiding who she is. In Capital City, she’s in demand, but when Lennox learns the truth, can he win Wifey back from five wailing babies?
books.title: (Dubbed) My Boss Is My Baby’s Father

books.description: Luna transmigrates into a beast-world novel as cannon fodder. The original host tortured her five forcibly bonded beast husbands nearly to death, and the plot has them killing her in revenge. She proposes a blood ritual to break the bond, offering her father's location. They journey together, fighting monsters, managing heat cycles, dividing beast cores, unaware their hatred has softened.
books.title: Realm of Fated Beasts

books.description: Sterling Hale rules Hale Group, ignoring wife Elaine—until a boardroom storm makes him declare, "She is my wife." The marriage was no contract but his protection. Shirley Hale, abused three years, dumps her CEO ex, suitors flock—she is the light he can never reach. Too late, but no one lets go.
books.title: My love came many years too late

books.description: Cornered by her stepsister Clara Moore, Isabella Moore ends up spending the night with tycoon Ashton Carter by mistake while being used as a stand-in. Five years later, she returns with her twins and embarks on a glamorous revenge journey as a double-faced designer. She seizes back control of the Moore Family Group with her own hands. Meanwhile, the man who mistook someone else for his beloved five years ago is now begging for her forgiveness. This time, she wants both fame, fortune and love.
books.title: The Substitute's Revenge： CEO, I Have Your Twins

books.description: Wolf king Caleb abandoned rabbit Ivy, who bore quintuplets alone. To save her youngest, she returns and meets Caleb, seeking his heir. Amid a forged prophecy, villains and crises, the ex-lovers must trust again, protect five children. When their powers awaken, can the family break fate and reunite?
books.title: The Five Cubs Are Here The Wolf King’s Bunny Wife

books.description: Elowen, chief trainer at Morlin Dino Park, is penalized and stripped of her bonus by a new director, who promotes an inexperienced well-connected hire and imposes new regulations. She refuses unpaid overtime, and clashes with management who trust operation manuals over hands-on experience. Ignored and fired, she watches the dinosaurs spiral out of control, plunging the park into major crisis.
books.title: The Dragon‑Tamer’s Boundary

books.description: College student Rhine takes a maid job for $800 and accidentally catches a dragon mob boss’s eye. After one night, he slips away — only to later give birth to a fire-breathing dragon egg and raise the baby dragon alone.
books.title: My Soumate Is a Mafia Dragon

books.description: Harvard prodigy Luna Carter drops out to work at Hayes Group, affording her ailing mother life-saving medication. A freak accident binds her to CEO Ethan Hayes through shared sensation - one feels the other's pain. Pregnant with quintuplets, she faces suspicion, Stella Bennett's sabotage, and a loveless bargain. The bond strips his armor; he falls for her, reunites the Hayes family.
books.title: Bound By Body：The CEO's Quintuplets

books.description: Distanced by her Alpha mate due to his uncontrollable powers, a despairing Luna accidentally summons his 20-year-old, passionately devoted self. Torn between adult Kael's late regrets and young Kael's fierce protection, she chooses self-love, leaving the toxic past to start an independent life with her younger love.
books.title: Craving His 20-Year-Old Self

books.description: My new roommate is gorgeous, dangerous… and hopelessly obsessed with me. She scares away anyone who gets too close, spoils me like a princess, and promises to protect me from anyone. But when I discover she’s the daughter of a mafia boss, I realize falling for my roommate might be the most dangerous thing I’ve ever done.
books.title: Sleeping with My Mafia Princess

books.description: Walters Group goes bankrupt. Sophia, egged on by Edward, hands son-in-law Tristan divorce papers—but the "loser" is Fox Tail Group's secret CEO, ruling world economy. He returns, crushes Edward, seizes her company as top creditor, and makes her sign a humiliating exclusive contract—his caged canary.
books.title: Married To Jerk Ceo

books.description: Mia Wilson, a girl from a modest background, had just been pressured into her 58th blind date when she went ahead and married her boss in a whirlwind wedding.Luxury cars, and a mansion were immediately transferred into her name. Is this her salvation—or has she fallen into an even bigger conspiracy? Who’s the hero and who’s the villain? Watch how she takes charge of her own life and plays her own game
books.title: Flash Marriage: My Billionaire Boss’s 100-Day Trap

books.description: Teacher Emily slips down stairs into a unicorn kingdom, becoming royal nanny to seven untamable unicorns. With treats and songs she wins the Flame baby's trust, exposing the cruel steward. When the Rainbow and Tide babies are locked in the West Tower, she joins the king to rescue them, falling into a living illusion where a crisis could destroy them.
books.title: Whispering to Unicorns, Won the Cold King’s Heart

books.description: They had shared a decade of childhood sweethearts romance, yet he would not marry her. Elowen Mercer vanished into thin air overnight. Five years later, she returned home with a pair of adorable twins. She hid and evaded, only to be cornered by him in the end.
books.title: Genius Cute Baby, Dark-minded Daddy

books.description: Barrel racer Riley died under a falling billboard on victory night. Reborn at 22, 250 pounds and mocked by her town, she's bound to the "Second Life System": each pound lost earns a Rodeo Queen skill. Bullied by Savannah and distrusted by Colt, she slims down, wins the Denim Queen race, advances to WPRA qualifying, and exposes the frame-up. Lone Star offers a contract; Riley signs and rides on.
books.title: Dumping My Bull Rider After I Slimmed Down

books.description: After catching her husband Ray Shaw with her best friend, Quinn Hughes walks away with her daughter Shanna, only to learn her farmer father, Dawson Hughes, is Upton Group Chairman. She rises to CEO as Ray faces the fallout. But when Ray returns from prison with a knife at Shanna's 15th birthday, the past comes for blood.
books.title: My Ex Threw Out a Billionaire Heiress

books.description: Rabbit Omega Eli hides his Alpha identity at Sacred Beast Academy. Stopping bullies reveals he's fated to four top Alphas—domineering Caleb, gentle Julian, beguiling Dante, distant Rowan. Sharing their home, he grows close, first liking Julian until possessive Caleb wins his heart. Jealous Jessica plots; his cover blows and she's expelled. Backed by Caleb, Eli wins a tournament, then confesses.
books.title: I Posed as an Alpha and Became the Prey of Four Alphas

books.description: Emma and her husband accidentally win $50 million, only to be killed for it by a friend of 15 years and her bestie. Reborn to the night of the draw, she hides the win to save him, yet he'd rather trust the killers than her. Hunted and betrayed, she plays a fake ticket and the villains' greed against each other to survive and take revenge.
books.title: Jackpot Night: $50 Million to Die For

books.description: Nora West hides her heiress name to fund her husband's rise as his angel investor. Day one home with the baby, his "girl best friend" Chloe already knows the baby's body better than his own mother. The tally hits 100. Then the truth: her baby was stillborn. The one in her arms is Chloe's. The naming ceremony is her trap.
books.title: My Husband’s Girl Best Friend

books.description: A one-night stand with heir Jax sends Sophia running. Two years later he's back with a baby and a DNA test: Jax is a merman—men give birth in his world, and she's his mate for life. But Sophia is married to Noah, who wants the child she dreads. As her marriage crumbles, she must choose: the husband who broke her, or the merman who'll never let go.
books.title: My Merman Baby Daddy Won’t Let Go

books.description: 2025 champ Riley Morgan pulls off her helmet. A light rig falls on her. She wakes in 2005: 27, plus-size, a stranger's face. Ethan hands her divorce papers, $800 owed, his pay gone to Blake. Three days to clear it and revive the dead #27. The test rig that crushes Ethan's leg? Blake signed off. Not forgiveness - a place beside him.
books.title: I Died a Champion, Reborn in Her Body

books.description: On inauguration day, Mayor Vicente's mother, Donna, is towing extorted by corrupt officer Bob while rushing her dying grandson to the hospital. Bob's sister Bella—Vicente's fiancée and police chief—doesn't know Donna is her future mother-in-law. When the truth explodes, Vicente destroys the corrupt pair and sends them to prison.
books.title: Tow My Car. Your Whole Family Goes to Jail

books.description: Betrayed by her family, Elena endures three years of abuse before returning home to more cruelty. A powerful mafia boss she once saved offers her love and protection. As the truth emerges, her brother begs for forgiveness, but Elena chooses a new life.
books.title: My Brother's Punishment

books.description: Sylph, a simple-minded girl, is forced to wed Astur, the crippled, poisoned Beast King, in her sister's place. Her pure innocence wins his heart. She tames beasts with sincerity, reveals sacred healing magic, saves him from death, and cures his legs. Reawakened, she regains her wits, exposes her sister's crime, and finds true love.
books.title: The Dragon's Silly Captive

books.description: Believing in her perfect marriage, Catherine discovers a secret in a crooked family portrait: her son isn’t hers. Her husband, Vikram, swapped her daughter Maya for his mistress’s son, Aaron. On Aaron’s birthday, Catherine throws Vikram out and takes back everything. Reunited with Maya, she helps her enter medical school and rebuilds her family.
books.title: The Secret Behind the Family Portrait

books.description: To repay his orphanage's $5 million debt, Arthur enters a deadly horror game—only to receive a romance system. With Samantha, a ghost nurse, at his side, he outwits the asylum's monsters and defeats its final boss. He makes it home, but his next nightmare awaits: Horror High School.
books.title: Horror Game: My Halloween Girlfriend Is an S-Rank Ghost

books.description: Disguised in a worn jacket, the nation's hidden Black billionaire visits his own bank to withdraw a gift for his future son-in-law—only to be racially humiliated, beaten and nearly fed to a tank of venomous blue-ringed octopuses by a white teller, her manager father, and his gold-digging fiancé, who has no idea he's torturing the real chairman. At the group handover gala, he lets them hang themselves on live camera.
books.title: Big Mistake: Torturing The Hidden Billionaire

books.description: Billionaire heiress Elena secretly funds Ethan's family for seven years while being treated as a useless housewife. Abandoned during a vacation, she cancels a $5 million investment and files for divorce, then returns as CEO of Sinclair Holdings, reclaiming her assets and never looking back.
books.title: His Billionaire Wife Walked Away

books.description: Gage dreams: an underground hockey win, heat, six Alpha rivals unmasking him. Awake, a flawed succubus, he passes as human: no pheromones, never in heat. At his sister's sleazy Ice Blaze assistant audition, he shields her and catches a star's puck barehanded. Intrigued, the six make him their live-in assistant. His traits awaken, risking exposure.
books.title: The Male Succubus That Sets Ice Ablaze

books.description: Scorned by the wolf pack as weak human Ember wakes with a gift—she can hear every wolf cub's inner voice. While other maids fail, she calms the crying Alpha baby, soothes terrified cubs, wins over every difficult pup. But catching cold Alpha Torin's attention has a price. He once threatened her life... yet his soul burns to claim her as his Mate.
books.title: The Alpha’s Baby Whisperer

books.description: Max was once an overweight college outcast betrayed by his best friend Seth and crush Jessica. After rebirth, he makes a deal with a succubus, gaining cash-back powers and a stunning transformation. Now rich and attractive, Max exposes their lies, defeats his enemies, and wins the heart of heiress Ruby.
books.title: My Succubus Glow Up

books.description: In an apocalyptic shelter draft, Leon gets stuck with a useless, Common water tower. Then Leon unlocks "Hand of God," fusing his tower into a floating fortress of undead. But power brings a terrifying truth: the apocalypse isn't a game, and the System built all lords just to butcher them!
books.title: Fortress Royale: Infinite Shelter Upgrades

books.description: In the Lower City slums, Evan Cole's dying gift—a beast egg—hatches Alia, a mocked ant queen whose blood pact unlocks her S-rank power: devouring beasts to evolve an ant army. He ranks first in the academy trial, uncovers House Vale's dark magic and Abyss lord Valhan, achieves Symbiosis, slays Valhan, saves Lower City, and wins Upper City status.
books.title: My F-Rank Bug is the S-Rank Hive Queen
